question: Should pending Skill Workshop approvals be permanently bound to the proposal version that the operator reviewed, requiring a fresh review after any revision?
rationale: The code and proof support both the implementation and its safety rationale, but the behavior intentionally changes how delayed operator approvals recover after a proposal revision; that policy cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Endorse fail-closed review binding
options.body: Keep the proposed behavior so approval, rejection, and quarantine from a pending prompt apply only to the exact proposal version shown to the operator.

options.title: Preserve latest-version lifecycle behavior
options.body: Keep previews read-only but do not bind pending lifecycle actions to a reviewed version, accepting that an older prompt may act on a newer proposal.

options.title: Narrow the feature first
options.body: Land only the review projection and defer version-bound pending approvals to a separately discussed approval-policy change.

recommendation.title: Endorse fail-closed review binding
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed behavior so approval, rejection, and quarantine from a pending prompt apply only to the exact proposal version shown to the operator.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a cross-channel product and operator-safety policy rather than a local implementation detail.
